question: Salal Hydroelectric Power Station is built on which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salal power station** is the run-of-the-river scheme with an** installed capacity of 690 MW** to harness th**e Hydropower potential of river Chenab.**
 
• The** Power Station was commissioned in the years 1987, 1993,1994, and 1995.**
 
• It is l**ocated in Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• The beneficiary states of this power station are Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Jammu and Kashmir, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, and Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This dam is India's first dam to be built on a rock pedestal, and Jammu's largest hydroelectric project.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagirathi:**

 
 
• It is a Himalayan River that flows in Uttarakhand state.
 
• It is one of the two headstreams of the pious Ganga River.
 
• This river has a length of 205 km and a basin of about 6,921 sq, km.
 
 
 
• **Jhelum:**
 
 
• It is a river in the northern Indian subcontinent.
 
• It originates at verinag and flows through the Indian-administered territory of Jammu and Kashmir, to Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Kosi:**
 
 
• The river Kosi also called Kosi is called the sorrow of Bihar.
 
• The river gained its name as the sorrow of Bihar due to the annual floods that affect the state most of the time during the rainy season.
